birth.author: Elias Lönnrot, compiler and editor
birth.locator: Rune I · Birth of Wainamoinen; Rune I · Birth of Wainamoinen, normalized characters 1225-1290
birth.excerpt: Seven hundred years she labored Ere her first-born was delivered.
birth.note: Verbatim English verse translated by John Martin Crawford from Lönnrot's nineteenth-century compilation of oral poetry; not a transcript of one ancient or single oral witness.

narrativeBlocks.title: A birth across generations
narrativeBlocks.body: Rune I describes Ilmatar carrying her child for seven hundred years before Väinämöinen is delivered.

narrativeBlocks.title: The long birth
narrativeBlocks.body: Source quotation (Crawford's English translation; whitespace normalized): “Seven hundred years she labored Ere her first-born was delivered.”

narrativeBlocks.title: A compiled epic speaks
narrativeBlocks.body: This is John Martin Crawford's English translation of Elias Lönnrot's nineteenth-century Kalevala, an edited compilation of Finnish and Karelian oral poetry.

narrativeBlocks.title: Not a single ancient manuscript
narrativeBlocks.body: The Kalevala is a modern national epic compiled from oral materials, not one unchanged ancient text or a record of every Finnish or Karelian performance.

narrativeBlocks.title: Name the actual witness
narrativeBlocks.body: For this lesson, the witness is Rune I in Crawford's English translation of Lönnrot's compilation. Keep its edition and sequence visible.
